title: Fixed Open Slotted Optical Drum

The spindle enters the solid floor of one continuous connected open-top cylindrical drum, whose lower wall rises into twelve broad upper panels separated by twelve genuine narrow top-open vertical viewing slots. A complete thick ivory band is fixed inside the lower drum wall, carrying one invented sequence of twelve small dark ball-height relief marks. True central cavity, slot mouths, under-drum gap, collar shaft bore and material thickness are geometric rather than decals. All new numeric construction; no old domed herb-censer lid, pleated lantern, dual-reel projector or imported mesh instances. One whole prop and zero scenes; slots and phase motifs are not separate reusable models. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Small fixed material overlaps establish the display assembly. Static art only: no spinning, image animation, persistence-of-vision effect, pupil/view alignment, optical performance, working bearing, educational efficacy, fabrication, mechanical strength or safety claim. The interior motifs are a fictional fixed pattern, not a verified functioning optical sequence.
